title: EPI-LEAN semantic registry
description: Schema for the EPI-LEAN semantic registry: human-authored mathematical interpretations attached to Lean declarations. A 'reviewed' status is a workflow annotation, never a machine-verified truth claim.

registry_version.description: Version of the registry format itself.

declaration.description: Exact Lean declaration name the entry refers to.

interpretation.description: Concise mathematical interpretation of the declaration.

status.description: Review status. 'reviewed' is a human workflow annotation, not a machine-verified truth claim.

evidence.description: Supporting source, definition mapping, or reviewer note. Required in practice for 'reviewed' entries (enforced by EPI-LEAN's loader, not by this schema).

reviewed_by.description: Identifier of the human reviewer, for 'reviewed' entries.

reviewed_at.description: Date of the human review (ISO 8601 recommended).

origin.description: Whether the interpretation was authored by a human or proposed by an AI system. AI proposals must never be auto-marked 'reviewed'.

references.description: Optional pointers to mathematical literature or documentation supporting the interpretation.
